parsed_entries.requirement: A Data Principal must exhaust the opportunity of redressing her grievance under this section before approaching the Board.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document provides a process for resolving grievances internally before allowing appeals to the Board.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures that Data Principals follow internal grievance mechanisms before seeking external redress.

parsed_entries.requirement: A Data Principal shall have the right to nominate any other individual to act on their behalf in the event of death or incapacity.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document allows for the nomination of a representative to act on behalf of the Data Principal in case of death or incapacity.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures that Data Principals can designate a representative to manage their data rights in case of incapacitation.

parsed_entries.requirement: The term 'incapacity' includes inability to exercise rights due to unsoundness of mind or infirmity of body.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document defines 'incapacity' to include mental or physical conditions that prevent the exercise of data rights.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement clarifies the definition of incapacity for the purpose of data rights.

parsed_entries.requirement: A Data Principal must not register false or frivolous grievances or complaints with a Data Fiduciary or the Board.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document prohibits the registration of false or frivolous grievances or complaints.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures that the grievance process is not abused by submitting false complaints.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Central Government may restrict the transfer of personal data by a Data Fiduciary to countries outside India.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document provides for the possibility of government-imposed restrictions on cross-border data transfers.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement allows the government to impose restrictions on data transfers to foreign jurisdictions.

parsed_entries.requirement: The applicability of Indian laws providing higher protection for data transfers outside India is not restricted by this section.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document acknowledges that higher protections for data transfers outside India may be provided by existing Indian laws.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures that existing Indian laws on data transfer protections remain applicable.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Central Government may notify certain Data Fiduciaries, including startups, that are exempt from specific data protection provisions.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document allows for the exemption of certain Data Fiduciaries, including startups, from specific data protection provisions.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement allows for the exemption of certain entities from specific data protection obligations.
